BrochureContent.Content:
Gordon Hughes is presenting to the market an exciting opportunity to acquire a detached 3 bedroom dormer property in a sought-after & convenient location beside the town of Ballinamore. This property offers an excellent blank canvas for someone looking to create a beautiful home with the benefit of being located across the road from the Shannon-Erne waterway & within easy reach of all services & amenities including shops, schools etc.
The existing property has a traditional bungalow-style layout, with generous windows providing excellent natural light and views towards the surrounding greenery. The property also benefits from a detached garage/outbuilding offering useful additional storage or potential for future use, subject to the necessary permissions. While the property requires renovation and finishing works, this presents an opportunity for a purchaser to transform the existing building to their own specification and taste. The structure provides a great starting point for creating a modern, comfortable home while retaining some of the property's original character. Accommodation comprises; Hallway, Open plan kitchen/dining/living space, sunroom, kitchen, utility, bathroom & No.3 Bedrooms (2 ensuite). Viewing Strictly by Appointment Only with Sole Selling Agent.
